newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Spector plans cap increase - paper.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Spector plans cap increase - paper.

text.p: Belgian Spector Photo Group NV, Europe's second-largest independent photo processing group, plans a one billion franc capital increase to finance recent acquisitions abraod, Belgian financial daily De Financieel-Economische Tijd said on Thursday.
Earlier this year, Spector bought a majority stake in Swiss photo group Porst and 100 percent of Interdiscount France from Swiss group Interdiscount.
The paper said it expected the operation to be launched in mid-October.
It also said that Spector was willing to open Interdiscount France's capital to its present management or to an outside partner.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
